subject: MSA redline: staging carveouts, pen-test notice, SOC 2 evidence mapping
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@helixhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@helixhealth.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: Clarify pen-test window and SOC 2 evidence for order form

Hi Karthik / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked us to surface a couple of items before we can finish the PO: 1) confirmation of the pen-test scope & access model (we want to run a vendor scan against the staging environment), and 2) what SOC 2 artifacts and time range you will include for the order (attestation PDF + control mappings).

Can you confirm whether:
- Staging access can be scoped to a tenant and limited to a two-week window;
- Pen-test results will be delivered to us directly (PDF) and a redacted version retained by Redwood;
- SOC 2 report will include the six core TSC assertions with an accompanying mapping doc to items in the MSA security exhibit.

Procurement is pushing for language in the order form that makes inspection windows concrete — they prefer 10 business days notice and a maximum of one full-scope onsite/inspection per year. If you have a suggested clause we can share with legal, please send it.

Appreciate your help,

Sarah Lim
Director, Security & Compliance
Helix Health
[Attachment: Helix_NDA_Exec.pdf (pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pen-test window and SOC 2 evidence for order form

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear asks. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a scoped pen-test on staging and provide SOC 2 attestation + a controls mapping. A few operational/legal details we need to align on before we commit final language:

1) Scope carveout: staging-only, specific tenant(s), and test harness limitations (no data exfil, rate caps).
2) Notice and frequency: operations prefers a 7-business-day scheduling window for ephemeral credentials; legal historically targets 10 business days for formal inspections. We should pick one to avoid mismatch.
3) Results handling: Redwood can provide a full report to the customer and retain a sanitized copy for our records; we will not publish raw exploit code.

I'm attaching the current MSA redlines with a proposed paragraph for "Inspection and Penetration Testing" (MSA_redlines_v1.docx). Jonas, can you review the legal language below and flag anything that would block procurement or create long-term liability? Laura — can you confirm whether the ops team can support a 7-day window or needs 10?

Proposed short paragraph (for discussion):
"Customer may request limited penetration testing of Redwood's staging environment limited to Customer's tenant(s). Redwood will coordinate access and scheduling, provide ephemeral credentials for a mutually-agreed window not to exceed fifteen (15) calendar days, and require written notice at least ten (10) business days prior to test start. Redwood reserves the right to impose technical guardrails to prevent data exfiltration and to suspend testing that violates the guardrails."

Next steps: I'll collect legal feedback today and aim to share a consolidated response + DocuSign-ready order form by EOD Friday if we can lock the language.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MSA_redlines_v1.docx (docx)]

From: jonas_weber@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 16 Jul 2025 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pen-test window and SOC 2 evidence for order form

Karthik — quick legal read. I made three suggested edits in the attached redline (see comments in MSA_redlines_v1.docx):

1) Limit inspection language to "bounded inspection" with an express carveout that production data is not in scope and that access is limited to non-production tenancy. This keeps our exposure narrow and aligns with SOC 2 expectations.

2) Change the notice period to 10 business days in the contract language (I know ops suggested 7, but 10 is a reasonable legal trade-off and common in our other deals). We can operationally accept a 7-day internal SLA but the contract should say 10 business days to give us buffer.

3) Add an evidence-handling paragraph: Redwood will deliver the SOC 2 attestation (PDF) covering the most recent reporting period and a controls mapping document (CSV) that ties each control to the relevant MSA clause. For penetration testing, the clause will require the customer to accept a redacted executive summary for public sharing; the raw technical report is shared under a controlled disclosure letter and subject to the NDA.

I'm tagging Marissa for any pricing/SLA implications of an extended remediation window or mandatory redaction review.

Attachments in this thread: MSA_redlines_v1.docx (with inline comments).

-Jonas
General Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 17 Jul 2025 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pen-test window and SOC 2 evidence for order form

Folks — ops notes and constraints below. We can support staged pen-tests but need to coordinate on these operational controls to avoid production impact:

- Scheduling: stagger tests across tenants; prefer 10 business days notice for schedule stability but can do 7 if customer accepts potential blackout windows.
- Credentials: ephemeral keys will be generated for a single test window and automatically expire. We need the test start/end timestamps in the request payload.
- Throttle & blast radius: we will enforce rate limits and a kill-switch; vendor must sign the vendor test rules (included in infra-runbook.pdf).
- On-call: I'll assign on-call support for the window; please include the on-call pager number in the contract exhibit.

Operational ask: we need procurement/Helix to confirm whether the vendor will use their own tooling or Helix's approved vendor list — different vendor profiles require different staging topology.

I attached the infra runbook and a draft ops schedule (ops-schedule.csv) with available windows in August and September.

Laura Bennett
Director, Platform Ops
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: infra-runbook.pdf (pdf); ops-schedule.csv (csv)]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@helixhealth.com>, procurement@helixhealth.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Jul 2025 15:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Clarify pen-test window and SOC 2 evidence for order form

Sarah — thanks, all internal feedback in thread. Short consolidated reply and ask for procurement/legal at Helix:

1) Contract language: Redwood will accept 10 business days' notice (per legal) and will limit pen-tests to non-production tenancy. We will include the evidence-handling paragraph (SOC 2 PDF + controls mapping CSV) and a controlled-disclosure rule for raw pen-test output.

2) Ops checklist: staging window (7–15 calendar days), ephemeral creds, throttle/kill-switch, and an ops on-call number. Laura attached available windows — please pick a candidate week.

3) Docs & signature: I'm attaching a DocuSign-ready order form link (DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/hellink/abc123) that reflects the proposed MSA redline updates. If Helix legal is comfortable, procurement can approve and we can provision staging access once we receive the signed order and 10-business-day notice for the test start.

Requested action items for Helix:
- Confirm the vendor you plan to use (approved list or new vendor).
- Pick an available test week from Laura's ops-schedule (attached).
- Confirm acceptance of the controlled-disclosure approach for pen-test raw output.

If we get signoff by next Wednesday EOD, we can target an August test window. Jonas — please mark the redline as "final" if there are no further legal objections. Marissa — please confirm there are no pricing credits or SLA changes required for this arrangement.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
[DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/hellink/abc123]
